result:
Posts can now be scheduled with an optional "Publish at" date-time. `bun run typecheck` passes. I also checked the behaviour with a temporary test covering guest, other-user, and author visibility, search, 422 on a non-date, past and null dates, time passing, and edit set/clear. All five passed, and I deleted the test afterwards.

The changes are in `db/schema.ts`, `app/Models/Post.ts`, `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`, `app/Policies/PostPolicy.ts`, `app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`, `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`, and the four pages under `resources/js/pages/posts/`. A new nullable `published_at` column comes with migration `db/migrations/20261019151911_add_published_at_to_posts`, generated by `guren make:migration`. A small helper in `resources/js/lib/publish-at.ts` converts the browser's local time to UTC. The index, search, and show views all apply the same rule. A scheduled post stays hidden until its time passes, and its author still sees it. I also changed `PostController.update` to call `authorize('update')`. It had no check before, so any signed-in user could edit someone else's scheduled post and publish it early. As a result, non-authors now get a 403 on `PUT /posts/:id`. The store path now uses `create(..., { set: { authorId } })` instead of `forceCreate`, as the audit recommended. The `.guren/*.gen.ts` files were regenerated by codegen. `guren audit` still reports one high-severity advisory in `source-map-js`, which I did not touch.
